title: Pressure Washing in Belleview, FL | House & Driveway
description: Pressure washing in Belleview, FL: soft wash for siding and stucco, pressure for driveways and walks. Mildew, algae, and pollen removed without damage.
h1: Pressure Washing in Belleview, FL for Houses, Drives, and Walkways
heroIntro: Green streaks on stucco, black mildew under eaves, and a gray driveway are standard Belleview problems. We clean them with the right method for each surface.

questions: How do I get green algae off my stucco?
Is soft washing safer than pressure washing?
Should my house be washed before it is painted?

body: In Belleview's humid climate, anything that stays damp grows something. We see algae streaks on the lower stucco of newer homes where irrigation hits the wall, mildew on the soffits and fascia of older houses, and dark staining on concrete driveways, walkways, and patios. Pressure washing in Belleview, FL handles all of these, but not with one method.
bullets: Stucco and block walls with algae streaks
Soffits, fascia, and eaves with mildew
Storefronts and walkways for downtown businesses

sections.h2: Two methods, matched to the surface
body: Painted walls, stucco, and wood are cleaned with a soft wash: a cleaning solution applied at low pressure that kills mildew and algae, followed by a gentle rinse. High pressure on those surfaces can etch stucco, strip sound paint, or push water behind trim. Concrete is different. Driveways and walks get higher pressure to lift ground-in dirt that a soft wash would not touch.
Our guide to mold on siding explains why growth returns and what slows it down.
Gutters, screens, and lanai frames collect their own grime and can be added to the scope. We note each item on the estimate so you know exactly what is being cleaned and by which method.

sections.h2: The first step of every exterior repaint
body: On a painting job, washing is not optional. Paint applied over mildew, chalk, or pollen will not bond, and it fails early. Our exterior painting in Belleview always begins with a wash and mildew treatment, followed by drying time before repairs and primer. Washing also reveals hidden cracks and soft wood that need attention before paint.
Spring pollen deserves a mention too. The yellow film on screens and light-colored walls can stain if left too long; our article on cleaning pollen stains covers it.

Standalone washing can be booked year-round, though many owners time it for late spring, after pollen season, or early fall, before the holidays. When washing is part of a paint or stain project, it goes on the calendar as its own prep day, with drying time built in before anything else happens. Walkthroughs are usually scheduled within 48 hours, and the written estimate follows within one business day.

sections.h2: Care for your yard and property
body: Before we wash, crews protect plantings, close windows, and cover outlets and fixtures. Low-VOC and eco-conscious products are available. Every surface to be cleaned is listed on the written estimate. Read more about our pressure washing and soft washing service or return to the Belleview location page.

faqs.q: Can you wash my Belleview house without painting it?
faqs.a: Yes. Washing is available as a standalone service as well as the first step of a paint or stain project.

faqs.q: Will soft washing hurt my plants?
faqs.a: We protect plantings before cleaning and rinse them afterward, and eco-conscious products are available.

faqs.q: Can you clean my driveway and house in one visit?
faqs.a: Yes. The house gets a soft wash and the concrete gets pressure washing, both on one estimate.

faqs.q: Do you wash commercial storefronts in downtown Belleview?
faqs.a: Yes. We can clean storefronts, walkways, and building exteriors, scheduled around your business hours.
